evidence.detail: Merged 2024-08-07: 'Say how many runs before the next confirmed cards in hype message' — adds 'Next new cards confirmed in N runs time' (go-in timing only)
soonest_new_card computed from max_hits_in_undecided but no equivalent 'soonest elimination' exists; shows 'runs time' not 'hours'
background_task_rotation_hype fires on IntervalTrigger(hours=1), confirming 1 run == 1 hour so the conversion is trivial

triage.fix_sketch: In magic/rotation.py rotation_hype_message(): add min_hits_in_undecided = min([c.hits for c in cs if c.status == 'Undecided'], default=threshold) and soonest_elimination = TOTAL_RUNS - runs + min_hits_in_undecided - threshold + 1; add a 'Next elimination in {soonest_elimination} hours' line; rename 'runs time' to 'hours' on line 179. Touch only magic/rotation.py, ~8 lines.
triage.notes: The 'go in' half was done by PR #12968; the 'or out' half and the runs→hours labeling remain. TOTAL_RUNS=168 over 7 days confirms 1 run per hour.
